title: P104: attain the last reporting tick funded by the complete binary word
body:
[Paper: A sharp exponent bound for the fixed P104 binary word](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1fffcbd0a925a3cd493623b80b82cb961fa38c6d/research/p104-balanced-fusion-residual/manuscript/ARTICLE.md)

## A matching bound for one complete binary inventory

Under the five inherited P104 premises, this seven-stage signed multiplier attains **κ ≥ 0.003890115286594461** in the ideal fixed-alphabet multitape bound `O(n(1 + log n)^(1 − κ))`. This is 16 reporting ticks above the six-stage #8044 and Ali Romman’s seven-stage #8042. The directed raw crossing lies strictly between 0.003890115286594461129996942 and 0.003890115286594461129996943. The attained rate remains below that crossing. The 0.00389046 target remains 0.000000344713405539 higher.

For each rank r, subtract its paid count from its productive count. Below rank eight each coefficient is negative. Above eight each upper tail is positive. Summation by parts proves that the signed moment divided by 8^t increases strictly for t ≥ 0, where t = 1 − c. A separate rank-one bound disposes of t ≤ 0. Two directed dyadic sign enclosures then give a unique crossing and a global upper bound for this word’s funding test. No higher multiple of 10^−18 can pass it.

To attain that bound on the reporting grid, change the binary price to 287039844436133239/2^66 and rebuild its transport. Install seven binary height logarithms 2·10^12·16^i, numerical height 36,000 and stopping gap 10^−21. The complete 36-call binary inventory has 18,906 productive and 104,904 paid labels across 24 transport cells. Its normalized surplus exceeds 3.1153·10^−21. The two-copy numerical service has 105,216 productive and 564,144 paid labels over 48 calls and 54 cells. Its rate exceeds the ordinary booking by over 3.8321·10^−6. The 11/8 and 39/256 debits, seven bookings, 54 strict conditions and four functional conditions are included. At these heights all funded dyadics with at most 64 binary places fail even the relaxed ordinary recurrence. A 65-place price passes the raw and ordinary tests. The full construction in this PR uses 66.

## Source and scope

The operative source is #8042 at e26425171238e142cc9ffb510fd953f344bd41c7. Its follow-up dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd supplies the written seven-stage tape-role and historical-store argument. This package checks its parameter hypotheses, including the widened 66-root precision accounting, and pins the source, role inventory and fence tests. The conditional implication uses all-column native action, owned erasure and restoration, compiler transfer, precision and tape accounting, and analytic recovery. The scheduled high-water accounting remains a written source-to-machine argument for review. The full production-size payload is beyond host replay.

Native word #8027 at fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4. Signed predecessor #8035 at ea776471bf8ed143a0625cf2d7532f65d15eb5f9. Six-stage comparator #8044 at c3746ea769fcf0d20818d7e18366f1b602e4aa3d. #8048 at 9b4bb847d7573c8e08827fee22e9bcad8c9bb43c is an earlier-source price result with a different open storage obligation. #8049 studies a changed word for the larger target. Canonical main is e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. The five-file replay prerequisite from #7257 is 0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026.

## Reproduction and controls

From the checkout run `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-retimed-dyadic-endpoint/verify.py MODE`. The seven registered modes are `price`, `install`, `schedule`, `physical`, `receiver`, `slabs` and `product`. Each mode passed locally. Fixed setup took 264.24 s, returned 14,915,531 exact fractions and opened zero operand-dependent calendars. The serial physical replay took 348.79 s and included the full raw word, zero and independent nonzero states, 105,216 returned owners, dense and precision controls. The small signed product took 118.25 s, used 138 CRT shuttles and 157,248 H calls, and returned −345550037539. It selected the local H kernel. The unchanged-price control rejects the new rate. The signed and historical fence controls exercise feasible cases.

The source-only Lean file checks the literal bookings, strict inequalities and the adjacent reporting tick relative to the supplied raw upper endpoint. Lean 4.8.0 and 4.34.1 passed at trust zero. All 31 axiom reports were empty, a fresh import passed, the 4.34.1 kernel rechecked the compiled object, and both corrupted source variants were rejected. The real-power enclosure and complete machine are covered by separate written and executable evidence. The 60-file committed-byte and mode preflight passed. A fresh committed export reproduced the price case in 40.01 s, including the depth bound and three source-corruption rejections.

Ali Romman supplied the retimed transport, physical suppliers, signed multiplier and stage-store argument. DreamingOfClouds’ #7852 motivated the investigation. Clear1nsight coordinated the research and submission with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in deriving proofs, implementing independent checks and preparing the manuscript.
